message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Basic Version)** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round and by collecting cards from opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• One card is turned face up to start the discard pile; the rest form the draw pile. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw from the draw pile. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color and the next player draws four cards (must be used only if you have no matching color). | | **Drawing** | • If you cannot play a card after drawing, your turn ends.
• If the draw pile runs out, shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. | | **Going Out** | When you play your last card, shout “Uno!” (if you’re down to one card). If you forget, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Scoring** | After a player goes out:
• All other players add the point value of each card left in their hand:
 – Number cards = face value.
 – Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points.
 – Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
• The round winner’s score is added to their total. | | **Winning** | First player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | --- ### Quick‑Start Cheat Sheet | Card | Value | Effect | |------|-------|--------| | 0‑9 | Face value | Play if same color or number | | Skip | 20 | Next player loses turn | | Reverse | 20 | Change direction | | Draw Two | 20 | Next player draws 2 & loses turn | | Wild | 50 | Choose new color | | Wild Draw Four | 50 | Choose new color; next player draws 4 & loses turn (only if no other playable card) | **Tip:** Keep an eye on what colors your opponents are running low on—this helps you decide when to play a Wild or Wild Draw Four. Enjoy playing Uno!
